name: Stephens unified multivariate association framework (Gaussian implementation)
model_likelihood: Single-predictor outcome partition model; Gaussian implementation uses Bayesian multivariate regression with iid error rows and a common covariance.
prior: Conjugate inverse Wishart covariance prior and matrix normal coefficient prior in the Gaussian implementation.
inference_algorithm: Analytic partition-specific marginal likelihoods and Bayes factors; Bayesian model averaging over partitions.
estimand: Posterior probability of the global null and of direct, indirect and absent association patterns and marginal outcome categories.
data_input: Single predictor with multiple related outcomes; centered genotype-outcome and outcome cross-products plus genotype variances support summary-data evaluation.
tunable_settings: Partition prior weights; effect-size scale grid and weights; covariance-prior hyperparameters; phenotype coordinate system
